## Verification

- [ ] Reference solutions and tests pass
- [ ] Misconception paths fail for the intended reason
- [ ] Reset, cancellation, and failure behavior are tested where relevant
- [ ] Content schema and references validate
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings use synthetic data only
- [ ] Documentation and decision records are updated

## Learning evidence

- [ ] Independent performance is defined
- [ ] Delayed retrieval is defined when retention is claimed
- [ ] Transfer is defined when flexible use is claimed
- [ ] Hint or scaffold level is recorded
- [ ] Learner observation is planned or completed

## Fun and agency review

- [ ] The mechanic’s motivational purpose is explicit
- [ ] The learner makes a meaningful choice or action
- [ ] Rewards represent real capability or artifacts
- [ ] The change avoids guilt, coercion, answer dependence, and meaningless XP
- [ ] A removal or revision condition is stated for experimental mechanics

## Accessibility

- [ ] Keyboard path reviewed
- [ ] Screen-reader semantics reviewed
- [ ] Reduced-motion path reviewed
- [ ] Meaning does not depend on color alone
- [ ] Captions, transcript, and untimed equivalent considered where relevant

## Privacy, safety, and integrity

- [ ] No real learner or sensitive data is committed
- [ ] Untrusted code remains isolated and bounded
- [ ] AI output remains grounded and schema-validated
- [ ] Academic-integrity behavior is reviewed
- [ ] Cybersecurity content remains authorized and controlled
- [ ] Financial findings are appropriately qualified
- [ ] Third-party licenses and notices are recorded
